title: pix_opencv_contours
description: `pix_opencv_contours` finds contours in an incoming binarized image, passes the GEM list through its first outlet, and outputs contour-related data and summary information from its other outlets. Messages can select the contour hierarchy level (`-1` outputs all contours by default, while `-2` outputs contours with no child) and enable contour, convex-hull, convexity-defect, or table output.
